MODIFIER_STACKING_ANALYSIS.description: Vinyl siding repaint has dramatically simpler modifier stacking than wood siding repaint. No DSD, no RRP, no siding_profile modifier.
MODIFIER_STACKING_ANALYSIS.worst_case: QT3 (1.15) x scaffold (1.60) x full_sun (1.15) x cold_temp (1.30) = 2.77x
MODIFIER_STACKING_ANALYSIS.resolution: No stacking partition needed. All modifiers apply to all applicable tasks. Maximum stack well under 4.0x cap.

all_variable_rate_tasks.formula: effective_rate = base_rate / (FAC_VNRP_QT x FAC_EXT_ACCESS x FAC_EXT_WIND x FAC_EXT_SUN_EXPOSURE x FAC_EXT_SURFACE_TEMP)
all_variable_rate_tasks.max_stack: 1.15 x 1.60 x 1.25 x 1.15 x 1.30 = 3.44x (theoretical extreme — moderate wind + full sun + cold temp simultaneously is meteorologically improbable)
all_variable_rate_tasks.note: FAC_VNRP_QT applies to qt_scaled tasks only. Environmental modifiers apply to all non-fixed tasks.

fixed_tasks.note: Administrative gates, equipment setup/cleanup are fixed-time tasks. No modifiers applied.

siding_surface_input_group.description: Rate per SF applies to net siding field area from PaintScope. Engine divides SF by rate to calculate hours.

task_production_rates.name: Crew Mobilization & Equipment Staging
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Mobilize crew, transport materials and equipment to site. Stage primer, finish paint, spray equipment, and protection materials. Verify material against spec. ~45 min per setup session.

defect_tolerance.QT2: All materials on-site and verified against scope
defect_tolerance.QT3: All materials on-site and verified against scope, binder type confirmed on PDS

task_production_rates.name: Warranty Void Acknowledgment Gate
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Administrative: client signs warranty void acknowledgment before any production begins. Painting vinyl voids manufacturer finish warranty. ~10 min including explanation.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Document signed before work commences
defect_tolerance.QT3: Document signed before work commences

task_production_rates.name: LRV Verification Gate
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Administrative: verify selected color LRV against project spec. Confirm standard (55+) or IR-reflective (35-55) material path. Reject LRV <35. ~10 min.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Color LRV verified against product data sheet
defect_tolerance.QT3: Color LRV verified against product data sheet

task_production_rates.name: Scaffold / Lift Setup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Erect scaffold, position aerial lift, or stage extension ladders per access plan. OSHA-compliant setup with fall protection. ~60 min.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Access equipment set up and stable
defect_tolerance.QT3: Access equipment set up, level, plumb, tied off, fall protection in place

task_production_rates.name: Landscape Protection Setup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Deploy plastic sheeting and tarps over adjacent landscape beds and plantings. Stake and secure. ~18 sec per SF.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Major plantings covered, gaps tolerable at perimeter
defect_tolerance.QT3: Full coverage of all adjacent landscape with secured edges

task_production_rates.name: Hardscape Protection
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Deploy drop cloths on walkways, patios, and driveways adjacent to working elevations. ~14 sec per SF.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Drop cloths covering primary traffic paths
defect_tolerance.QT3: Full hardscape coverage with taped edges at foundation

task_production_rates.name: Window Spray Masking
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Paper or masking film over window glass + tape around frame. ~7.5 min per window. Spray method requires full glass masking.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Glass covered, minor tape gaps at corners tolerable
defect_tolerance.QT3: Full glass coverage with clean tape lines at all edges

task_production_rates.name: Door Spray Masking
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Full cover door with masking film or plastic. ~12 min per door. Doors are larger than windows.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Door fully covered
defect_tolerance.QT3: Door fully covered with clean sealed edges

task_production_rates.name: Corner Trim Masking
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Tape line or paper mask at siding-to-trim junction when trim is different color. ~1 min per LF.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Tape line applied along trim edge
defect_tolerance.QT3: Clean tape line with paper backing where needed

task_production_rates.name: Light Fixture Masking
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Bag and tape light fixtures. ~4 min per fixture.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Fixture bagged
defect_tolerance.QT3: Fixture bagged with sealed tape edges

task_production_rates.name: HVAC Unit Cover
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Wrap condenser unit in plastic sheeting and tape. ~10 min per unit.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Unit covered with plastic
defect_tolerance.QT3: Unit fully wrapped with taped seams

task_production_rates.name: Utility Panel Masking
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Mask electrical panel, gas meter, hose bibs. ~5 min per unit.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Panel covered
defect_tolerance.QT3: Panel fully masked with sealed edges

task_production_rates.name: Mix Alkaline Cleaning Solution
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Mix TSP or dedicated vinyl siding cleaner concentrate with water per manufacturer directions. Load into pressure washer downstream injector or pump sprayer. ~10 min.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Solution mixed per manufacturer ratio
defect_tolerance.QT3: Solution mixed per manufacturer ratio, ready before wash starts

task_production_rates.name: Pressure Wash Vinyl Siding
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Pressure wash 500-1000 PSI with alkaline cleaner in downward spray pattern. Removes dirt, mildew, chalk residue. Midpoint 750 SF/hr. ~5 sec per SF. Mandatory first production step.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Visible dirt and mildew removed, minor chalk residue acceptable
defect_tolerance.QT3: All dirt, mildew, and chalk fully removed. Hand-rub test confirms no chalk transfer.

task_production_rates.name: Post-Wash Chalk Residue Test
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: After drying, perform hand-rub test on representative areas to verify chalk removal. Test 3+ areas per elevation. ~1.8 sec per SF equivalent. QT3 only.

defect_tolerance.QT3: Test 3+ areas per elevation. Document results. Re-wash if chalk transfer detected.

task_production_rates.name: Light Scuff Sand for Adhesion

QT2.notes: Spot scuff on high-gloss areas and visible chalk zones only

QT3.notes: Full-surface scuff on all elevations. Uniform matte appearance after scuffing.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: 220-grit light scuff sand to create adhesion tooth on smooth PVC. Or liquid sander (Krud Kutter) as alternative. MUCH lighter than wood siding prep — no scraping, no feather-sanding.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Scuff marks visible across field, some untouched areas acceptable
defect_tolerance.QT3: Uniform scuff pattern across all surfaces, no glossy untouched areas

task_production_rates.name: Post-Scuff Dust Cleanup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Compressed air or tack cloth to remove sanding dust from vinyl surface before priming. ~6 sec per SF.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Visible dust removed from field surfaces
defect_tolerance.QT3: All dust removed, tack cloth shows clean on final pass

task_production_rates.name: Caulk Joint Assessment
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Inspect siding-to-trim joints for failed caulk. ~18 sec per LF to probe and mark. QT3 only.

defect_tolerance.QT3: All joints inspected and failed sections marked for replacement

task_production_rates.name: Spot Caulk Replacement
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Remove failed caulk, clean joint, apply siliconized acrylic caulk, tool smooth. ~48 sec per LF. QT3 only.

defect_tolerance.QT3: Smooth, continuous caulk bead, no gaps, no smears on adjacent surfaces

task_production_rates.name: Adhesion Primer — Spray Application
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Airless spray STIX-class adhesion primer on vinyl PVC. Full coverage single coat. No backbrushing — vinyl is non-porous. Midpoint 400 SF/hr. ~9 sec per SF.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Full coverage, no bare PVC visible, minor runs at J-channels acceptable
defect_tolerance.QT3: Full even coverage, no runs, no sags, uniform film build

task_production_rates.name: Adhesion Primer — Brush/Roll Application
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Brush edges, roll field with 3/8 nap roller for adhesion primer. STIX-class primer is thick — roller application is slower. ~29 sec per SF.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Full coverage, no bare PVC visible
defect_tolerance.QT3: Full even coverage, smooth roller finish, no holidays

task_production_rates.name: Finish Coat 1 — Spray Application

QT3.notes: Standard — even mil build, consistent appearance across all elevations

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Airless spray 100% acrylic latex finish on primed vinyl. No backbrush (non-porous PVC). Higher rate than wood siding spray (no backbrush coupling). ~7-8 sec per SF.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Uniform color coverage, minor overspray at transitions tolerable
defect_tolerance.QT3: Uniform color, no runs, no sags, clean transitions at J-channels and trim

task_production_rates.name: Finish Coat 1 — Brush/Roll Application

QT2.notes: Economy — adequate coverage, minor stipple tolerable

QT3.notes: Standard — smooth lay-off, maintain wet edge

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Brush edges, roll field with 3/8 nap roller for finish coat. Smooth vinyl surface allows slightly faster roll than wood. ~26-30 sec per SF.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Uniform color, minor roller stipple acceptable
defect_tolerance.QT3: Uniform color, smooth lay-off, no roller lines or holidays

task_production_rates.name: Finish Coat 2 — Spray Application

QT3.notes: Same rate as coat 1 spray. Primed/sealed vinyl surface is consistent.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Second and final spray finish coat. QT3 only. ~8 sec per SF.

defect_tolerance.QT3: Uniform color with full hide, no runs, no sags, clean transitions

task_production_rates.name: Finish Coat 2 — Brush/Roll Application
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Second and final brush/roll finish coat. QT3 only. ~30 sec per SF.

defect_tolerance.QT3: Uniform color with full hide, smooth lay-off, no roller lines

task_production_rates.name: Brush Detail — J-Channels & Under-Sill
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Brush-apply finish coat into J-channels, under-sill channels, and starter strip recesses. Estimate at 5-10% of total field SF as detail SF. Midpoint 150 SF/hr. ~24 sec per SF. QT3 only.

defect_tolerance.QT3: Full coverage in all channel recesses. No bare PVC visible in channels.

task_production_rates.name: Brush Cut-In at Trim Transitions
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Brush cut-in where siding meets corner trim, window casing, door casing, and soffit junction. Clean color line at siding-to-trim boundary. ~29 sec per SF equivalent. QT3 only.

defect_tolerance.QT3: Sharp color line at trim boundary. No bleed onto trim surface. Consistent line at 6 ft viewing.

task_production_rates.name: Final Walkthrough Inspection
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Walk all elevations and inspect completed siding finish for defects, holidays, coverage, and appearance. ~1.4 sec per SF.

defect_tolerance.QT2: No obvious misses or runs visible from 10 feet
defect_tolerance.QT3: No defects visible from 6 feet, clean transitions at all trim junctions

task_production_rates.name: Final Touch-Up
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Brush touch-up of defects found during final walkthrough inspection. ~1 sec per SF equivalent.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Obvious defects corrected
defect_tolerance.QT3: All defects corrected, repairs blended, J-channels uniform

task_production_rates.name: Remove All Protection Materials
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Remove all tarps, plastic, masking tape, fixture bags, window/door masks. Faster than setup — pull and fold. ~9 sec per SF equivalent.

defect_tolerance.QT2: All protection materials removed from site
defect_tolerance.QT3: All protection materials removed, no tape residue on surfaces, landscape inspected

task_production_rates.name: Scaffold / Lift Teardown
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Dismantle scaffold, return aerial lift, or stage ladders for removal. ~45 min.

defect_tolerance.QT2: All access equipment removed
defect_tolerance.QT3: All access equipment removed. No damage to landscaping or hardscape from equipment.

task_production_rates.name: Clean Spray Equipment & Tools
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Flush airless sprayer, clean spray tips and filters, clean brushes and rollers. ~30 min per session.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Equipment flushed and stored
defect_tolerance.QT3: Equipment flushed, tips cleaned individually, hoses coiled, filters replaced if needed

task_production_rates.name: Final Site Cleanup & Demobilization
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Collect debris, dispose containers, final site walkthrough. ~20 min. Shorter than wood siding repaint — no scraping debris, no RRP waste.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Site clear of materials and debris
defect_tolerance.QT3: Site clear of materials and debris, no overspray on adjacent surfaces, client walkthrough

factor_modifiers.name: Quality Tier Rate Modifier
factor_modifiers.description: Quality tier affects care and rigor on coating and detail tasks. QT2 economy = less care. QT3 standard = baseline.
factor_modifiers.notes: QT2 at 0.85x = slightly faster (less care, economy-grade work). QT3 at 1.00x = baseline standard. No QT4/QT5 — vinyl is not a fine-finish substrate.

factor_modifiers.name: Access Type Height Modifier
factor_modifiers.description: Access type drives production rate reduction for elevated work. Shared across all exterior specs.
factor_modifiers.notes: Applied per elevation. Protection setup/teardown, equipment setup/cleanup, and fixed administrative tasks are NOT affected.

factor_modifiers.name: Wind Condition Modifier
factor_modifiers.description: Wind condition modifier for spray operations. High wind is a STOP condition — forces method switch to brush_roll or work postponement.
factor_modifiers.notes: Applies to spray tasks only. High wind (>15 mph) is a STOP — spray work halted, switch to brush_roll method or postpone.

factor_modifiers.name: Sun Exposure Modifier
factor_modifiers.description: Sun exposure affects scheduling and daily productive hours. Full sun on vinyl is especially critical — hot PVC affects adhesion primer bond quality.
factor_modifiers.notes: Full sun forces early morning scheduling on south/west facades, reducing daily productive hours by ~15%. Applies to coating tasks only.

factor_modifiers.name: Surface Temperature Modifier
factor_modifiers.description: Surface temperature extends recoat intervals and affects adhesion primer cure. Vinyl siding has narrower optimal temperature range (50-85 deg F surface).
factor_modifiers.notes: Cold (<50 deg F surface): slow cure of adhesion primer, longer recoat intervals = 30% more time. Hot (>85 deg F surface): flash drying risk on PVC = 20% more time.

quality_effects.notes: Economy vinyl repaint. Adhesion primer (mandatory) + single finish coat. No J-channel detail. No caulk assessment. Appropriate for rental/cost-sensitive. Standard-grade 100% acrylic.
Standard residential vinyl repaint. Adhesion primer + two finish coats. J-channel brush detail. Caulk assessment at siding-to-trim joints. Mid-grade 100% acrylic. 7-15 year expected service life.

round_configurations.description: Adhesion prime (1 coat) + 1 finish coat — economy vinyl repaint
round_configurations.notes: Minimum viable vinyl repaint. Adhesion primer is mandatory (not optional). Single finish coat. Total: 2 coating passes.

round_configurations.description: Adhesion prime (1 coat) + 2 finish coats — standard vinyl repaint
round_configurations.notes: Standard residential repaint. Adhesion primer + two finish coats for better DFT and durability. J-channel detail included. Total: 3 coating passes + detail.

assumptions: Base rates are for lap_horizontal vinyl siding at ground access on sound substrate (SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT).
No stacking partition needed — maximum theoretical modifier stack is 3.44x, well under 4.0x cap.
Spray is primary application method. No backbrushing on vinyl (non-porous PVC). Spray/backbrush coupling rule does NOT apply because backbrushing is not used.
Environmental modifiers (wind, sun, temp) apply only to coating tasks. Prep and protection tasks are not environmentally sensitive for estimation purposes.
LRV class drives MATERIAL selection only, NOT labor rates. standard_55+ and ir_reflective_35-55 have identical production rates.
Adhesion primer is ALWAYS required — no conditional logic, no spot prime option. Every variant includes full prime.
Single substrate state (SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT) eliminates DSD modifier entirely. No scraping, no feather-sanding, no condition-driven prep branching.
No RRP gate — vinyl is never lead-painted. Eliminates RRP modifier, containment tasks, and waste disposal tasks.
No siding profile modifier — vinyl is effectively always lap profile. Board-and-batten vinyl is rare and minor.
Crew size = 1 for all tasks. Spray does not require a second person for backbrushing (unlike wood siding).
J-channel detail labor estimated at 5-10% of total field SF applied at brush detail rate. QT3 only.
Caulk tasks use LF input from PS_EXT_EDGE_LF.TRIM_CORNER. Estimator captures failed caulk LF during assessment.
24-48 hour dry time between pressure wash and priming is scheduling overhead, not production rate overhead.
risks: Adhesion primer bond failure on hot PVC surfaces (>85 deg F). Risk mitigated by environmental modifier and SOP gate for surface temperature.
Color LRV below 35 accepted without IR-reflective product = permanent thermal warping. Risk mitigated by LRV verification gate task.
Manufacturer warranty void may surprise homeowner. Risk mitigated by warranty acknowledgment gate task.
Persistent chalk residue after washing may not be detected until primer fails. Risk mitigated by hand-rub test in SOP and chalk scrub task.
Multi-story projects with scaffold access increase costs by 60%. Ensure access assessment is completed before scope commitment.

validation_plan.test: Spray production rate on vinyl — 400-500 SF/hr claimed vs field actual
validation_plan.method: Time 3 spray passes on standard lap vinyl siding at ground level. Record SF completed per hour.
Time STIX primer spray on vinyl siding. Note coverage rate (SF/gal) alongside production rate.
Time brush detail work at J-channels and under-sill channels on QT3 project.
Time masking of 10 standard windows with paper and tape.

validation_plan.test: Pressure wash rate on vinyl — 750 SF/hr
validation_plan.method: Time pressure wash of standard vinyl siding elevation. Note PSI used and cleaner type.
Compare timed spray at ground vs ladder on same surface profile. Calculate actual ratio.
